Feature.Description: Read the current pose of a DENSO robot over b-CAP. The server is stateless: each command opens a b-CAP connection, acquires the robot, runs the pose command (robot_execute "CurJnt" / "CurPos"), then releases the robot and disconnects. The robot is selected as the first robot reported by the controller. These commands only read; they do not move the robot.

Command.Description: Get the current joint angles via robot_execute(robot, "CurJnt"). Returns the J-type value as a list of reals (J1..J6 in degrees, plus any auxiliary axes).

Response.Description: The current joint angles, in the order returned by CurJnt.

Command.Description: Get the current Cartesian position via robot_execute(robot, "CurPos"). Returns the P-type value as a list of reals (X, Y, Z in mm; RX, RY, RZ in degrees; the trailing figure value as a number).

Response.Description: The current Cartesian position, in the order returned by CurPos.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Failed to connect to or communicate with the robot controller over b-CAP.
Failed to acquire the robot or execute the pose command (e.g. no robot is available).
